judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A striking mountain scene with cloud spilling over the ridge, but it works more as a landscape than as a dedicated sky photograph.
strengths: Cloud spilling over the ridge adds motion and texture
Strong contrast between snow, dark trees, and white cloud
weaknesses: Sky occupies a limited portion of the image
